_help: Focus F-39. Every song the game can play (scripts/Music.cs). 'category' is one id or a list of ids from 'categories'. The picker asks where the hero is: a boss lair > a dungeon > the hero's home (within homeRadius metres of the home storage chest) > a town (data/towns.json zones) > night or the Shadow realm (World.Night above nightAt) > exploring. It plays a song of the first of those that is switched on (Settings > Audio > Music) and has a song switched on; with none, silence. 'loops': how many times a seamless song plays through before the quiet gap (the tools/music_gen.ps1 songs loop without a seam). 'vol': 1 = as recorded. Categories with 'loop' keep one song going while the hero stays (boss lairs); 'urgent' ones switch at once. Numbers: gap = seconds of quiet between songs, firstGap = before the first one, fade = crossfade seconds, settle = seconds a new place must hold before the song changes, minPlay = seconds a song plays at least before a change of place may replace it, volume = loudness of the Music bus at 100%.
